auth.note: Public gists require no auth; private gists require GitHub session (same cookie as github.com)

_meta.note: Gists run on a separate origin from github.com. The extension's <all_urls> host_permissions covers this origin. Payloads targeting gist.github.com must use base_url: https://gist.github.com. Do NOT use github.com base_url for gist payloads — the tab discovery will not find gist tabs.
